run_textcaps_evaluation: run the textcaps evaluation script with a prediction file and annotation file to compute captioning metrics
run_textcaps_val_set: run the textcaps evaluation script on the validation set using --set val with pred and annotation files
run_textcaps_train_set: run the textcaps evaluation script on the train set using --set train with pred and annotation files
summarize_print_metrics: summarize the print_metrics function which prints Bleu, METEOR, ROUGE_L, SPICE, and CIDEr captioning scores
review_coco_caption_eval_integration: review how the script integrates coco_caption_eval.calculate_metrics to compute image captioning evaluation metrics
